description: This file implements the GstCapabilities class and related factory functions for managing GStreamer media capabilities, including supported MIME types, decoder capabilities, and parser-decoder chain validation within the Rialto server media framework.

classes.name: GstCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media capability queries, including supported MIME types, decoder capabilities, and parser-decoder chain validation.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating GstCapabilities instances.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns supported MIME types filtered by media source type (audio/video).

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.

methods.name: fillSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Populates the set of supported MIME types based on available decoders and parser-decoder chains.

methods.name: getSupportedCapsFromDecoders
methods.description: Retrieves supported capabilities from available decoder elements.

methods.name: appendSupportedCapsFromParserDecoderChains
methods.description: Extends supported capabilities by considering parser-decoder chain possibilities.

methods.name: canCreateParserDecoderChain
methods.description: Determines if a parser-decoder chain can be created for given decoder capabilities and parser pad templates.

methods.name: addAllUniqueSinkPadsCapsToVector
methods.description: Adds unique sink pad capabilities to a vector, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: isCapsInVector
methods.description: Checks if a given GstCaps object is already in a vector of GstCaps.
